figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2. A. Gene cluster loci of SlACAS (green arrow) and SlTE (yellow arrow) in S. lycopersici. B. Domain organization of SlACAS. C. Alignment of MβL-TEs: SlTE,
DhTE, HyTE, ElTE and ReTE. Sites with the same amino acids are shaded in black, and those with similar amino acids are shaded in gray. The conserved catalytic
triad for hydrolytic activity is marked with asterisks. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this ﬁgure legend, the reader is referred to the Web version of
this article.)

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 3. A. HPLC analysis (at 440 nm) of the products of the S. cerevisiae BJ5464-NpgA engineered strains: ScP as the empty control (i), ScPT1 (ii), ScPT4 (iii), ScPT3
(iv), ScPT2 (v), ScPT5 (vi). B. Time course of the production of 1, 2 and 3 by ScPT1. C. Titers of 1, 2 and 3 generated by the engineered S. cerevisiae BJ5464-NpgA
strains at 7 days of cultivation: ScP (SlACAS) as an empty control, ScPT1 (SlTE), ScPT2 (HyTE), ScPT3 (ElTE), ScPT4 (ReTE), ScPT5 (DhTE). Error bars represent the
standard deviations of three replicates.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 4. A. Gene cluster loci of HyACAS (green arrow), HyTE (yellow arrow) and HyDC (red arrow) in Hypoxylon sp. EC38. B. Alignment of decarboxylases: AfDC,
HyDC, PaDC, PsDC, TaDC, ThDC and TpcK. Sites with the same amino acids are shaded in black, sites with similar amino acids are shaded in gray. C. HPLC analysis
(at 440 nm) of the products of the S. cerevisiae BJ5464-NpgA engineered strains: ScPT2 (SlACAS-HyTE) as an empty control (i), ScPTD6 (SlACAS-HyTE-TpcK, ii),
ScPTD7 (SlACAS-HyTE-ThDC, iii), ScPTD4 (SlACAS-HyTE-TaDC, iv), ScPTD2 (SlACAS-HyTE-PsDC, v), ScPTD5 (SlACAS-HyTE-PaDC, vi), ScPTD1 (SlACAS-HyTE-
HyDC, vii), ScPTD3 (SlACAS-HyTE-AfDC, viii). D. Time course of the titers of 1 and 3 produced by ScPTD6. E. Time course of the titers of 1 and 3 produced by the
ScPTD3. F. Conversion rate of 1 to 3 catalyzed by diﬀerent decarboxylases. Error bars represent the standard deviations of three replicates. (For interpretation of the
references to colour in this ﬁgure legend, the reader is referred to the Web version of this article.)
